description: Family 6 (docs/tasks.md section 7): a clearing instance in the terms of US 2021/0004796 A1 (R14 of the paper). Every value here is a bench decision; the application supplies the construction, not parameters.

provenance.construction: given: R14 (nodes are addresses with positions, edges weighted by trade amounts, an external settlement value, ghost links to connect subgraphs, zero-sum settlement)
provenance.market: invented: prices in sats per unit of one instrument; a link costs 100 ppm, a ghost link 2000 ppm; the base fee is zero in v0 so that the ceiling is exact
provenance.collateral_ppm_of_gross_payable: invented: collateral is set after the settlement value to 110% of each trader's gross payable, so every plan is fundable
provenance.cells: invented: dense bilateral trading; a sparse ring with chords where multilateral netting matters; the ring with links at 2% of notional, where ghost links or longer paths are needed
